name: JG_FSCL_DOC_SEQUENCES_F
description: This table contains setup information for Fiscal Document Sequence number.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier for the fiscal document sequence.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOCUMENT_SERIES_ID
columns.description: Fiscal document series associated with the sequence.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: Sequence identifier that is based on the Receivables sequence setup.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity identifier representing the first party.

columns.name: LEGAL_REPORTING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Legal reporting unit identifier.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the fiscal document sequences setup is enabled for the series, legal entity, and legal reporting unit. Valid values are Y and N.
